Maya (CS): Heads-up: OrbisAI's monthly forecast jumped ~35% overnight after a bulk ingestion. QBR on Monday — we need a tidy mitigation plan + slide.
Evan (FinOps): Aware. Can someone confirm which calls spiked? embeddings, chat, or rerank?
Rosa (Onboarding): Embeddings. They pushed a migration that re-embeds old docs and accidentally used the high-dim flag. Continuous re-embeds ran every 5m.
Dev (Solutions): Yep saw config: `embed.dimension=1536`. They should be on 512. Also re-embed job reties were set to immediate so failures retried quickly.
GuardBot: :warning: Project ORB-7 at 84% monthly credits.
Evan (FinOps): If unmitigated extra monthly spend ~ $10.4k. Fast mitigations: 1) pause re-embed job, 2) flip to embed-512-quant, 3) add dedupe + chunk-caching. Which is fastest to deploy?
Rosa (Onboarding): Pause = 10s. Model flip = config patch (couple mins). Dedupe and caching need brief code change but we can enable a read-through cache at the proxy level quickly.
Maya (CS): I'll message the customer that we paused the job and scheduled a 30m ops call. Need the slide to show impact, mitigation, and ask (credits buffer vs trial Dedicated).
Dev (Solutions): Technical mitigation steps (paste to ops):
```
# pause job (example)
POST /v1/projects/ORB-7/jobs/reembed/pause

# quick config patch
PATCH /v1/projects/ORB-7/config
{ "embedding": { "model": "embed-512-quant", "dimension": 512 } }

# soft quota example
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/ORB-7/quota" -d '{"soft_limit_pct":65, "hard_limit_pct":90}'
```
Evan (FinOps): Recommend offering: primary -> 10-day Dedicated micro pool trial (shows perf + predictable cost). Fallback -> 15% one-time credits buffer conditioned on adoption checklist. I'll put numbers on slide: model flip + cache ~= 63% cost drop; throttling adds 10-12%.
Maya (CS): Good. Also add renewal risk blurb: unexpected spend impacts trust. Credits buffer should be framed as a one-off smoothing concession.
GuardBot: :white_check_mark: Incident logged: ORB-cost-surge assigned to #customer-success.
Rosa (Onboarding): Paused re-embed at 09:41 PT. Requeues are held.
Dev (Solutions): Small runbook snippet for engineers to copy into their infra:
```
# throttle example (pseudo)
batcher.set_max_concurrency(6)
batcher.set_backoff(200ms)
# enable prefix caching
proxy.enable_cache(prefix_key=true, ttl=48h)
```
Evan (FinOps): I'll draft the slide with numbers and both ask options. ETA 90 minutes. Maya, can you draft the customer note? Keep it short and action-focused.
Maya (CS): Will do. Drafting now: short apology, paused job note, proposed ops call, and two mitigation options. Sharing in 30m for review.
Dev (Solutions): Also add appendix metrics: per-route token rate, percent repeated docs, avg seq length. Helps QBR convo.
Maya (CS): Action items: Evan finalize slide, Dev add appendix + runbook, Rosa keep imports paused, Maya draft customer message and schedule 30m ops call.
Rosa (Onboarding): Confirmed no re-embeds until explicit sign-off.
Evan (FinOps): Marking account renewal-risk=medium. Will notify AMs.
Maya (CS): Closing for now. We'll propose Dedicated trial + Redwood Optimize settings in the QBR and recommend a post-QBR technical adoption plan. Update thread after slide upload. :thumbsup:
